text: Products can be returned if they are undamaged and complete. You are allowed to try the product, but items showing signs of use will not be accepted. A return request can be made within 30 days from the delivery date. After 30 days, return requests are not accepted and the product will be evaluated under warranty. For returns using the contracted shipping company Anadolu Kargo, shipping is free by showing the return code at the branch. If you use your own courier, the shipping fee will not be refunded. Once the product reaches the warehouse and passes inspection, the refund will be processed within 5 business days to the original payment method. For cash on delivery orders, refunds are made to the account holder's IBAN.
